title: A7 output file: one line of ncert/diffs/<CHAPTER>.jsonl
description: A7 is pure SCRIPT (diff_pairs.py), no agent. Section 6.4 shape: '{pair: [old, new], identical, diff: [{old, new}]}'. The file is JSONL (one such object per line); this schema describes one line/object. Per Section 9/A7 procedure, 'Identical -> drop' — in practice the script should not write a line for an identical pair at all (A8's item is 'one non-identical pair'), so identical:true lines are not expected to occur in the written file even though the field is kept for conformance with the Section 6.4 data contract.

pair.description: [old_passage_id, new_passage_id], both from the A6 pair result.

identical.description: True if the word-level diff after normalise_quote found no difference. A moved page break never counts as a difference (A2 already joined split text).

diff.description: Word-level differing spans. Empty when identical is true.
